title: Richmond Agitation–Sedation Scale (RASS)
age_range: adults (ICU/ward); Paeds STG also lists RASS or COMFORT-B

sources.title: STG & EML Hospital Level Adults, 6th ed. 2024 (updated Mar 2026)
STG & EML Paediatric Hospital Level, 2025-2029 cycle (updated Mar 2026)
Sessler CN et al. The Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale. Am J Respir Crit Care Med 2002;166:1338-44

items.t: Overtly combative, violent, immediate danger to staff
Pulls or removes tube(s) or catheter(s); aggressive
Anxious but movements not aggressive or vigorous
Not fully alert, but sustained awakening (eye opening/eye contact) to voice (≥10 s)
Briefly awakens with eye contact to voice (<10 s)
Movement or eye opening to voice (but no eye contact)
No response to voice, but movement or eye opening to physical stimulation
No response to voice or physical stimulation

formulas.name: RASS
formulas.expr: Single score −5 to +4 (0 = alert and calm)

procedure.detail: Alert and calm → 0 · restless or agitated → +1 to +4

procedure.t: If not alert: say name loudly, ask to open eyes and look at you
procedure.detail: Eye contact sustained (≥10 s) → −1 · eye contact <10 s → −2 · any movement, no eye contact → −3

procedure.t: No response to voice: shake shoulder, then sternal rub if no response

interpretation_stg.t: Target RASS −2 to 0; lighter sedation preferred over deeper
Exclude and manage delirium before routine sedation
Analgesia first (analgo-sedation), then sedate if still needed
Sedation indicated for: severe acute respiratory failure, status epilepticus, raised ICP/TBI, status asthmaticus
CAM-ICU-7: RASS 0 = 0 · RASS ±1 = 1 · RASS >+1 or <−1 = 2 (altered consciousness)

sedatives.title: Commonly used sedatives in the ICU (Table 23.4)

notes.t: Record the score and the stimulus used; reassess after every dose change
Positive = agitation (look for pain, hypoxia, delirium, withdrawal); negative = sedation
RASS −4/−5: GCS and airway first — not a target outside ventilated care

discrepancies.t: STG Table 23.3 cites Khan 2017 (CAM-ICU-7) and Table 23.1 (BPS) cites Sessler 2002 — the two citations appear swapped; RASS source is Sessler 2002 (also cited at p.23.54)

dagger_note: d=true items are not in the SA STG (Sessler 2002).
card_note: ✚ = SA STG (pages listed above). Unmarked content: Sessler 2002 (original RASS paper, cited by the STG).
